INSERT INTO orders (company, city, phone, email, services, style, package,
                            ip_hash, user_agent)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
                CASE WHEN $8::text IS NULL THEN NULL
                     ELSE encode(sha256(($8::text || $9::text)::bytea), 'hex') END,
                $10)
        RETURNING id
